title: Get your bearings
outcome: Explain the agent loop and choose a folder for your first page.

title: Set up a safe workspace
outcome: Open your project in one agent with approval prompts on.

title: Make a page on your screen
outcome: Build a tiny page, identify its files, and explain why you need a save point.

title: Save your work
outcome: Make a commit, connect a remote, and check that your page can use static hosting.

title: Publish your first page
outcome: Open your public page in a private browser window and check the result.

title: Describe the change
outcome: Write a goal, inspect the project, and clarify one unfamiliar word.

title: Agree on a plan
outcome: Answer an interview and approve a bounded plan.

title: Give useful feedback
outcome: Use a reference and a screenshot to steer one change.

title: Keep your instructions
outcome: Record project rules and ask for one outcome-sized change.

title: Collect evidence
outcome: Try the app yourself and record what its tests actually prove.

title: Build a checking habit
outcome: Add a regression check and run the project gate.

title: Inspect the real result
outcome: Collect browser evidence and request an independent review.

title: Test as a new user
outcome: Challenge a checker and reproduce a user report.

title: Create safe save points
outcome: Ignore generated files, name a commit, and work on a branch.

title: Review before merging
outcome: Open a pull request and distinguish local checks from CI.

title: Recover safely
outcome: Practice conflict handling, isolated work, and undo in a disposable copy.

title: Protect working software
outcome: Diagnose permission failures and set a checkpoint policy.

title: Set the finish line
outcome: Give one task acceptance checks, a stop condition, and a budget.

title: Resolve the right problem
outcome: Separate a cause from a workaround and reconcile competing requirements.

title: Recover a drifting run
outcome: Check scope and resume from a known working checkpoint.

title: Keep decisions manageable
outcome: Resolve useful questions and cut a feature on purpose.

title: Manage the agent workspace
outcome: Inspect context, tool use, and the boundaries of a delegated task.

title: Question confident answers
outcome: Bound a persistent goal and check an agent claim against evidence.

title: Handle work you must supervise
outcome: Check a background job and identify steps only you can complete.

title: Understand your publish pipeline
outcome: Inspect the build and deployment result and document the live URL.

title: Plan recovery after launch
outcome: Choose a host and rehearse a rollback before adding a domain.

title: Build your own small app
outcome: Scope, build, verify, publish, and reflect on one app of your own.

title: Protect credentials
outcome: Map secrets and configure an API credential without exposing it.

title: Understand service boundaries
outcome: Map data sharing, sign-in, and browser access restrictions.

title: Try a backend safely
outcome: Separate local infrastructure from production and inspect its logs.

title: Handle outside failures
outcome: Distinguish mocks from live evidence and bound a slow dependency.

title: Make the app usable and shareable
outcome: Check data rights, asset licenses, performance, and accessibility.

title: Coordinate several changes
outcome: Map ticket dependencies and integrate changes with review checks.

title: Leave a useful handoff
outcome: Reconcile research and write a handoff another person can follow.
